title: Gatewarden Super Fortress
detail: GATEWARDEN | mobile harbour super fortress · Native ProGen3D grammar. Bow +X, dorsal +Y, starboard +Z. Time t is in seconds. · The root arguments set metres per design unit and seconds per harbour cycle. · Default study: t=0 gate closed and ferry outside; t=5 gate half open; · t=10 gate fully open and ferry sheltered; t=20 returns to the opening pose. · Geometry is self-contained. Five native rules are embedded from Spaceship Object Model v1. · Structure: Start > Gatewarden > named spatial objects > reusable geometry rules. · Hull, fortress, civic districts and port machinery · The central underside narrows to a dropped keel. The U-shaped forward cutout houses the gate. · Bow arm in starboard coordinates. The port arm mirrors the same rule.
